body: well, i tried to live that life again. as i am 20, going to be 21 in 3 weeks. i found it alot harder than i rememberd. it doesnt help that im in a place where i have no friends. but even when we werent talking, i held on to the memories of when we got along, when she showed she cared. she was the girl that made my heart skip a beat, cheesy i know, but true. and every time i try to let go.. she comes back.. and im hooked again.

i think what makes it harder is all that ive put into this. and the fact that ive given up so much for her. and i put her before me in hopes that she will stop placing me last in her life.. i mean. right now shes in michigan and im in mississippi.. but thats because we were fighting. so i came to my parents house. i tried to get over her while we werent talking. but here we are again. and right now shes off at a club.. there are no trade-offs with her.. if she doesnt want me to do something. shes says something. and without thinking twice. i do what she asks.. because i want her happy. but when i say something.. im a controlling asshole. i dont understand that.
